messages.subject: Calculation of M10
parts:
Hi,

First time here. Thanks to all the developers for the package. It's amazing!

In the first run of the package, I forgot to modify the winhr option because I wanted M10, not M5. In my understanding, since it's a part 2 option, I should be able to modify it without overwriting the part 1 calculations. Since I want L5 an M10, winhr = c(5,10) and I have to rerun everything. Am I missing something?

Thanks

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Calculation of M10
parts:
That is correct. You only have to re-run part 2 with arguments mode = 2 and overwrite = TRUE.

Best, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
